title: Add due dates to todo items
goal: Todo items accept an optional due date, and the list endpoint can return only overdue items.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /todos and PATCH /todos/:id accept an optional due_date in YYYY-MM-DD format; any other value returns 400.
GET /todos?overdue=true returns only items that are not done and whose due_date is before today (UTC).
Items created without a due date have "due_date": null; all existing tests still pass.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
